key.name: master-enabled
key.summary: Enable the live wallpaper

key.name: pause-fullscreen
key.summary: Pause the animation when a window is fullscreen on a screen

key.name: idle-speed
key.summary: System mode drift speed multiplier

key.name: shimmer
key.summary: Subtle vertical shimmer in System mode

key.name: music-speed
key.summary: Music mode speed multiplier

key.name: bass-gravity
key.summary: Bass pulls particles downward

key.name: bass-strength
key.summary: Bass gravity strength

key.name: beat-surge
key.summary: Beats surge the field along the drift axis

key.name: beat-strength
key.summary: Beat surge strength

key.name: beat-flash
key.summary: Beats flash particles white

key.name: stream-drift
key.summary: Network/pan activity pushes the field sideways

key.name: stream-strength
key.summary: Stream drift strength

key.name: disabled-screens
key.summary: Connector names of screens the wallpaper is hidden on

key.name: screen-orientations
key.summary: Per-screen rotation overrides as connector=rotation ("0","90","180","270")

key.name: palette-mode
key.summary: Color source: "arc" (built-in hue arc), "fixed" (user hue), "wallpaper" (accent extracted from the wallpaper image)

key.name: fixed-hue
key.summary: Base hue used when palette-mode is "fixed"

key.name: accent-shift
key.summary: Hue offset applied on top of the wallpaper accent

key.name: scene-preset
key.summary: One-click scene looks. Selecting one writes the scene's values into the individual settings below — every knob stays tweakable afterwards.

key.name: pointer-effect
key.summary: Particles part and swirl around the mouse pointer

key.name: pointer-radius
key.summary: Radius (px) around the pointer that affects particles

key.name: pointer-strength
key.summary: Pointer push strength

key.name: wallpaper-layering
key.summary: §6 optional depth layering: mask the wallpaper's foreground (dark regions) and fade the particles behind it so they appear to pass behind the silhouette. Default off; disabled entirely on any failure.

key.name: layering-threshold
key.summary: Luminance cutoff for the §6 foreground mask (pixels darker than this are foreground)

key.name: layering-invert
key.summary: §6 inverted layering: treat the BRIGHT areas as foreground instead — particles hide behind bright objects. Useful on dark/black wallpapers where the normal dark-foreground reading would cover the whole screen.

key.name: layering-mode
key.summary: §6 silhouette detection: "luminance" = brightness split (default); "edges" = object-boundary silhouettes for low-contrast images; "auto" = brightness first, edges fallback.
